rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Mail IMAP provides secure, TLS-only IMAP email access through stdio transport. It offers message parsing with text and attachment extraction, cursor-based pagination for large mailboxes, and multi-account support. Write operations (copy, move, flag, delete) require explicit opt-in. Built with Rust for performance and memory safety.
